newsitem.title: USA: Riscorp delays results, sees profitability.
newsitem.headline: Riscorp delays results, sees profitability.

text.p: RISCORP Inc said Tuesday that it is delaying the release of its fourth quarter and fiscal 1996 earnings because it its final year-end audit is not completed.
"While the company regrets the delay, it believes both its fourth quarter and full year 1996 results will be profitable," the company said in a release.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report earnings of $0.07 per share for the fourth quarter and $0.33 per share for the year, according to First Call consensus estimates.
The company said it would reschedule the release of its results after the audit is completed.
